caption: Mid-tempo folk-pop, 90 BPM, minor key, intimate and melancholic mood, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, steady bass pulse, cello entering in later verses, close-mic'd dry vocal, minimal reverb, clean production, no drums until verse 2, sparse percussion, emotional build
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The engine ticks and cools
On the wet asphalt below
I watch your window glow
Through the rain on the glass

[Chorus]
Your door is closed to me
I'm safe in this cold breeze
I watch your shadow move
And keep my love to me

[Verse 2]
You laugh at something small
I can't hear the words you say
The porch light cuts the dark
And I stay in the gray

[Chorus]
Your door is closed to me
I'm safe in this cold breeze
I watch your shadow move
And keep my love to me

[Verse 3]
My coat is on your mat
From a night I can't recall
You never see me stand
When the rain starts to fall

[Chorus]
Your door is closed to me
I'm safe in this cold breeze
I watch your shadow move
And keep my love to me

[Verse 4]
The clock strikes half past ten
I turn the key in the lock
I drive away again
Before you hear the knock

[Chorus]
Your door is closed to me
I'm safe in this cold breeze
I watch your shadow move
And keep my love to me

[Outro]
Your door is closed to me
I'm safe in this cold breeze
I watch your shadow move
And keep my love to me
Your door is open now
I'm standing in the light
I watch your shadow go
And let my love go by
